briefings.title: Investigating Linux Vulnerabilities with GPT-6 Cyber
briefings.tldr: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber model, paired with a custom vulnerability research pipeline, dynamically validated over 1,000 Local Privilege Escalation (LPE) exploits in the 40-million-line Linux kernel—resulting in 948 confirmed vulnerabilities and candidate patches—demonstrating how AI can massively scale human security expertise while reducing the burden on open-source maintainers.
